entities.name: Chiesa di San Clemente al Vomano
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: San Clemente al Volmano, also known as the Abbey of San Clemente, is a Romanesque-style, former-Benedictine church and monastery found in a rural site, on a hill above the Volmano River, in the frazione of Guardia Vomano of the town of Notaresco, in provincia di Teramo, Abruzzo, Italy.
